config.description: Optional dir for archived run_results.json history (glob-scanned).

config.description: Fully qualified DQ checks table, e.g. 'project.data_ops.quality_checks'.

config.description: Fully qualified DQ score-daily table, e.g. 'project.data_ops.quality_score_daily'.

config.description: Service account key path for BigQuery (ADC fallback supported).

config.description: Postgres connection string when DQ_BACKEND=postgres.

config.description: DQ result-table schema preset: 'generic' (default) or 'us-all'. Use DQ_COL_* env vars to override individual columns on top of the preset.

config.label: Override for the timestamp/date column on the DQ checks table
config.description: Override for the timestamp/date column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on DQ_SCHEMA preset.

config.label: Override for the check-type column on the DQ checks table
config.description: Override for the check-type column on the DQ checks table. Default 'check_type'.

config.label: Override for the status column on the DQ checks table
config.description: Override for the status column on the DQ checks table. Default 'status'.

config.label: Override for the dataset/source column on the DQ checks table
config.description: Override for the dataset/source column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

config.label: Override for the table/target-name column on the DQ checks table
config.description: Override for the table/target-name column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

config.label: Override for the severity/dimension column on the DQ checks table
config.description: Override for the severity/dimension column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

config.label: Override for the numeric failure-count column on the DQ checks table
config.description: Override for the numeric failure-count column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

config.label: Override for the message column on the DQ checks table
config.description: Override for the message column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

config.label: Override for the check_name column on the DQ checks table
config.description: Override for the check_name column on the DQ checks table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' to synthesize check_name from check_type and table_name.

config.label: Override for the date column on the DQ score-daily table
config.description: Override for the date column on the DQ score-daily table. Default depends on preset.

config.label: Override for the scope column on the DQ score-daily table
config.description: Override for the scope column on the DQ score-daily table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' if the table has no per-scope rollup.

config.label: Override for the tier column on the DQ score-daily table
config.description: Override for the tier column on the DQ score-daily table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' if the table has no tier dimension.

config.label: When no tier column is configured (us-all preset or DQ_COL_TIER=none), the overall_score threshold dq-tier-status compares against (default 99
config.description: When no tier column is configured (us-all preset or DQ_COL_TIER=none), the overall_score threshold dq-tier-status compares against (default 99.5). Superseded by DBT_SLA_CONFIG_PATH tier_sla.1 if both are set.

config.label: Optional path to a YAML file that defines tier_sla (per-tier overall_score targets) and dbt_sla (test/freshness pass rates)
config.description: Optional path to a YAML file that defines tier_sla (per-tier overall_score targets) and dbt_sla (test/freshness pass rates). When set, dq-tier-status and dq-tier-by-source read tier targets from this file, and dbt-sla-status compares run_results / sources pass rates against dbt_sla.test_pass_pct / freshness_pass_pct. Mtime cached.
